label: Khao Lak
short_description: Quiet Andaman beachfront resorts on Bang Sak and Bang Muang beaches, north of Phuket.
intro: Khao Lak's hotels in this directory line a stretch of Andaman coastline in Phang Nga province, roughly 90 minutes north of Phuket International Airport by road. The area rebuilt into a deliberately lower-rise, more spread-out resort destination than Phuket, so properties here tend to be large beachfront compounds with multiple pools and family facilities rather than dense hotel strips, and Khao Lak is also the main jump-off point for Similan and Surin Islands diving trips.
